sources.title: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2: Multilingual Sentence Embeddings ...
sources.snippet: The paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 model is a sentence-transformers model designed to produce semantically meaningful sentence embeddings. It maps sentences and paragraphs to a 384-dimensional dense vector space, enabling tasks such as clustering, semantic search, and paraphrase identification.
